_comment: Run 20261008 through the water-filled acrylic tube with three cameras: T0 = wand calibration, T1 = tracers. Lengths in mm, image coordinates in px (u = column, v = row, pixel centres at integers). Frames are counted by image number, the Phantom's count from the common trigger (the .chd header's FirstImageNo): a camera's file frame{k}.tif holds image number k + first_image. The top-level wand keys (raw_dir ... calibrate) are T0's, in the layout of the 6-7 Oct cases.
_cameras: From the .chd headers (p0a_files): sizes, serials, FirstImageNo. cam3 saved T0's images 2396-13000 only; cams 1-2 saved 0-13000. Pixel sizes: VEO 710L 20 um, v2640 13.5 um (Phantom data sheets). The user (8 Oct): every camera has the 180 mm lens, at roughly the same distance from the tube.

wand._comment: Assumed the wand of 6-7 Oct (10 mm, balls 3 and 4 mm); to confirm with the user.

tube._comment: As on 6-7 Oct: OD 7.9375 in, wall 0.125 in.

detect._comment: Cams 1-2, from the opening scan (p0d_wand_survey scan): ball radii about 32.5 and 46 px (7 Oct: 58-95 px), an opening of 51 px separates the rod (41-51 px in every frame, 61 loses the small ball); the opening and the rod mask scaled from 7 Oct's 95 / 50 px by the radii (x 0.55).

3._comment: cam3 (v2640, 13.5 um pixels): its balls are 1.5-1.57x larger in px (radii about 51 and 69 px; pixel-size ratio 1.48); an opening of 71-81 px separates the rod. Cams 1-2's lengths x 1.5.

accept._comment: The 6-7 Oct rules: a camera-frame is kept with two balls apart (the guard), both fits with an edge RMS at most edge_rms_max_px and an aspect ratio in aspect_range, and both sizes (sqrt(a b)) within size_tol of the camera's median for that ball. A frame enters the fit when at least min_cameras cameras keep it.

tracers._track_raw_frames: The user (8 Oct): tracking the first 250 frames is enough, to save time. Only these are copied locally and preprocessed; the background is the median of every 16th frame of the whole recording (p0b).

preprocess._comment: S1: the high-pass's median window per camera: 7 Oct's adopted 15 px (tests/cylinder_stb_study, report section 7) for cams 1-2; cam3's pixels are 1.48x smaller, so 15 x 1.48 = 22 -> 23 px (odd).
